metadata.description: MCP tool call throughput thresholds with 20% regression tolerance, floored at p50 1 ms / p95 5 ms / mean 1 ms

baseline.description: Baseline measurements from actual tool handler execution (MCP overhead without device I/O)
baseline.rule: threshold = max(floor, 3x the local max over 10 runs of 50 samples, rounded up to 0.1 ms), floor = p50 1 / p95 5 / mean 1 ms (scripts/benchmark-thresholds.ts THRESHOLD_FLOOR_MS, which the comparison also enforces). The 20% tolerance applies on top. Each sample is the per-call mean over a batch of calls sized to ~5 ms (chooseBatchSize), so sub-millisecond fake-backed handlers are measured above timer and scheduler noise. The gate is for regressions of a handler gaining a process spawn or real I/O (tens of ms) or becoming several times slower, not for microsecond drift: do not lower a threshold below its floor.
baseline.note: Measures tool registry lookup, schema validation, device resolution, and handler wrapper overhead. listDevices (#11332) is measured against fakes with a daemon-shaped DevicePool (see scripts/benchmark-listdevices-fixture.ts). observe, pressButton, tapOn, launchApp and installApp (#11375) are likewise measured against fakes (see scripts/benchmark-device-tools-fixture.ts; observe/tapOn serve the captured test/fixtures/observe/android-home.json, the other three return a canned success from the handler action seam). 2026-10-10 local maxima over 10 batched runs (p50/p95/mean ms): listDevices 0.044/0.445/0.254, pressButton 0.124/1.105/0.219, observe 0.123/0.217/0.151, launchApp 0.119/0.160/0.124, installApp 0.001/0.003/0.002 (all at the floor); tapOn 6.0/13.5/6.9 (kept at its prior 17.5/49.8/22.3, which is above 3x). getForegroundApp, inputText and swipe were removed: no tool is registered under those names.
